scope: GitHub PRs authored by this account, excluding repositories owned by the account; both result pages retrieved and deduplicated by canonical PR URL.
interpretation: PR counts include documentation, features, recoveries and drafts. They are not unique defect counts, original-fix counts, paid engagements or endorsements. A merge demonstrates acceptance of that contribution only.
